verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a programmatic usage or billing API, or any per-team or per-workload cost breakdown. Workspace budgets are a spend-limit control, and per-function logs and metrics are observability, not billing attribution. The generic SDK statement does not mention billing data, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can pull usage and billing breakdowns programmatically to attribute GPU spend by team or workload
